claims.text: Raffles Jakarta was founded by Dr (HC) Ir. Ciputra, an avid collector of Hendra Gunawan paintings.

findings.quote: Raffles Jakarta was founded by Dr (HC) Ir. Ciputra, an avid collector of Hendra Gunawan paintings.

claims.text: The hotel has installations articulating subjects from Gunawan's paintings, especially rural life and nature.

findings.quote: There are also installations articulating subjects from Gunawan’s paintings, especially the charm of rural life and the beauty of nature.

claims.text: The hotel is in the Kuningan district of Jakarta's golden triangle and is linked to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre.

findings.quote: Rising above the burgeoning commercial hub in the Kuningan district of Jakarta’s golden triangle, the hotel is linked to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre

claims.text: Rooms are infused with the creative influence of local artist Hendra Gunawan.

findings.quote: rooms are infused with the dazzling creative influence of the renowned local artist, Hendra Gunawan.

claims.text: The Raffles Club is on the 12th floor with views of the Jakarta skyline.

findings.quote: Located on the 12th floor of the Raffles, with spectacular views of the Jakarta skyline, the Raffles Club is an exclusive sanctuary in the heart of the city.

claims.text: Raffles Jakarta butlers are trained by Heilbron Hospitality and Aspire Globally.

findings.quote: Raffles Jakarta butlers are trained by Heilbron Hospitality and Aspire Globally

claims.text: Arts Cafe serves Continental and Asian a la carte dishes with a backdrop of Hendra Gunawan's artwork.

findings.quote: Enjoy Continental and Asian à la carte offerings, served in chic surroundings with a backdrop of Hendra Gunawan's vibrant artwork.

claims.text: Arts Cafe has a Japanese corner and desserts from Raffles Patisserie.

findings.quote: specialities from our Japanese corner, alongside delightful desserts from Raffles Pâtisserie.

claims.text: The Writers Bar hosts evenings of live jazz piano with signature rum cocktails.

findings.quote: Unwind to the smooth rhythms of live jazz piano, accompanied by signature rum cocktails and thoughtfully curated light bites.

claims.text: Raffles Spa has six treatment suites, an outdoor whirlpool and steam rooms, plus an outdoor pool.

findings.quote: hydrotherapy wellness with outdoor whirlpool and steam rooms
Rediscover your centre in one of our six beautiful treatment suites; or head for the outdoor pool

claims.text: The spa uses Kerstin Florian products for facials and Tropical Spa for body care.

findings.quote: The spa uses premium products of Kerstin Florian for facials and Tropical Spa for body care

claims.text: The Signature Heritage Massage incorporates Lomi Lomi, Balinese and Javanese techniques.

findings.quote: Experience Indonesian heritage through a head-to-toe massage incorporating Lomi Lomi, Balinese and Javanese techniques.

claims.text: Ciputra opened Raffles Jakarta in March 2015 as a place where Hendra Gunawan's legacy comes to life.

findings.quote: True to his word, in March 2015 he opened Raffles Jakarta as a place where Gunawan's legacy comes to life.

claims.text: The linked Ciputra Artpreneur Centre is home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, a gallery and a Broadway Musical Theatre.

findings.quote: the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre, home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, a gallery and a 1,200-seat Broadway Musical Theatre.

claims.text: Navina Pool Bar offers cabana dining in the Hendra Gunawan Garden on the 14th floor.

findings.quote: Discover a serene cabana dining experience at Navina Pool Bar, located in the Hendra Gunawan Garden on the 14th floor.

claims.text: A Raffles Royal Host is a historian with knowledge of the hotel and its art collection.

findings.quote: a Raffles Royal Host is a historian with encyclopaedic knowledge of the hotel and its art collection.

claims.text: Bathrobes are designed by IKAT Indonesia by Didiet Maulana, inspired by Hendra Gunawan artworks and local batik patterns.

findings.quote: Our bathrobes are designed by IKAT Indonesia by Didiet Maulana with design inspirations from Hendra Gunawan artworks as well as local batik patterns.

claims.text: Soekarno-Hatta International Airport is about 28 km away.
WhataHotel notes limited outdoor recreational facilities.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
